results.question: Can you list all tables in the SQLite database catalog?
results.sql:
SELECT name AS table_name
FROM sqlite_master
WHERE type = 'table'
ORDER BY name

results.question: which table stores customer's orders
results.sql: SELECT 'invoices' AS orders_table

results.question: How many customers are there
results.sql:
SELECT COUNT(CustomerId) AS customer_count
FROM customers

results.question: what are the top 5 countries that customers come from?
results.sql:
SELECT
  Country AS country,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerId) AS customer_count
FROM customers
GROUP BY Country
ORDER BY customer_count DESC, country ASC
LIMIT 5

results.question: List all albums and their corresponding artist names
results.sql:
SELECT albums.AlbumId AS album_id,
       albums.Title AS album_title,
       artists.Name AS artist_name
FROM albums
JOIN artists ON albums.ArtistId = artists.ArtistId
ORDER BY albums.AlbumId

results.question: Find all tracks with a name containing "What" (case-insensitive)
results.sql:
SELECT
  TrackId,
  Name AS track_name
FROM tracks
WHERE LOWER(Name) LIKE '%what%'

results.question: Get the total number of invoices for each customer
results.sql:
SELECT
  c.CustomerId AS customer_id,
  c.FirstName AS first_name,
  c.LastName AS last_name,
  COUNT(i.InvoiceId) AS invoice_count
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN invoices i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName
ORDER BY c.CustomerId

results.question: Find the total number of invoices per country:
results.sql:
SELECT BillingCountry AS country,
       COUNT(InvoiceId) AS invoice_count
FROM invoices
GROUP BY BillingCountry
ORDER BY invoice_count DESC

results.question: List all invoices with a total exceeding $10:
results.sql:
SELECT
  InvoiceId AS invoice_id,
  CustomerId AS customer_id,
  InvoiceDate AS invoice_date,
  BillingCountry AS billing_country,
  Total AS invoice_total
FROM invoices
WHERE Total > 10
ORDER BY Total DESC

results.question: Find all invoices since 2010 and the total amount invoiced:
results.sql:
SELECT
  InvoiceId AS invoice_id,
  CustomerId AS customer_id,
  InvoiceDate AS invoice_date,
  Total AS invoice_total,
  SUM(Total) OVER () AS total_invoiced_since_2010
FROM invoices
WHERE InvoiceDate >= '2010-01-01'
ORDER BY InvoiceDate, InvoiceId

results.question: List all employees and their reporting manager's name (if any)
results.sql:
SELECT
  e.EmployeeId AS employee_id,
  e.FirstName || ' ' || e.LastName AS employee_name,
  e.Title AS employee_title,
  m.FirstName || ' ' || m.LastName AS manager_name
FROM employees AS e
LEFT JOIN employees AS m ON e.ReportsTo = m.EmployeeId
ORDER BY e.EmployeeId

results.question: Get the average invoice total for each customer
results.sql:
SELECT
  c.CustomerId AS customer_id,
  c.FirstName AS first_name,
  c.LastName AS last_name,
  SUM(i.Total) / COUNT(i.InvoiceId) AS average_invoice_total
FROM customers c
JOIN invoices i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName

results.question: Find the top 5 most expensive tracks (based on unit price)
results.sql:
SELECT
  TrackId AS track_id,
  Name AS track_name,
  UnitPrice AS unit_price
FROM tracks
ORDER BY UnitPrice DESC, TrackId
LIMIT 5

results.question: List all genres and the number of tracks in each genre:
results.sql:
SELECT g.Name AS genre_name,
       COUNT(t.TrackId) AS track_count
FROM genres g
LEFT JOIN tracks t ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId
GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name
ORDER BY track_count DESC, genre_name

results.question: Get all genres that do not have any tracks associated with them:
results.sql:
SELECT g.GenreId AS genre_id, g.Name AS genre_name
FROM genres g
LEFT JOIN tracks t ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId
WHERE t.TrackId IS NULL

results.question: List all customers who have not placed any orders:
results.sql:
SELECT
  c.CustomerId,
  c.FirstName,
  c.LastName,
  c.Email,
  c.Country
FROM customers AS c
LEFT JOIN invoices AS i
  ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
WHERE i.InvoiceId IS NULL

results.question: There are 3 tables: artists, albums and tracks, where albums and artists are linked by ArtistId, albums and tracks are linked by AlbumId, Can you find the top 10 most popular artists based on the number of tracks
results.sql:
SELECT
  artists.Name AS artist_name,
  COUNT(tracks.TrackId) AS track_count
FROM artists
JOIN albums ON albums.ArtistId = artists.ArtistId
JOIN tracks ON tracks.AlbumId = albums.AlbumId
GROUP BY artists.ArtistId, artists.Name
ORDER BY track_count DESC, artist_name
LIMIT 10

results.question: List all customers from Canada and their email addresses:
results.sql:
SELECT
  CustomerId AS customer_id,
  FirstName AS first_name,
  LastName AS last_name,
  Email AS email
FROM customers
WHERE Country = 'Canada'
ORDER BY LastName, FirstName

results.question: Find the customer with the most invoices
results.sql:
WITH customer_invoices AS (
    SELECT
        c.CustomerId AS customer_id,
        c.FirstName AS first_name,
        c.LastName AS last_name,
        COUNT(i.InvoiceId) AS invoice_count
    FROM customers c
    JOIN invoices i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
    GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName
)
SELECT
    customer_id,
    first_name,
    last_name,
    invoice_count
FROM customer_invoices
WHERE invoice_count = (SELECT MAX(invoice_count) FROM customer_invoices)

results.question: Find the customer who bought the most albums in total quantity (across all invoices)
results.sql:
SELECT
  c.CustomerId AS customer_id,
  c.FirstName AS first_name,
  c.LastName AS last_name,
  SUM(ii.Quantity) AS total_quantity
FROM invoice_items ii
JOIN invoices i ON ii.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId
JOIN customers c ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName
ORDER BY total_quantity DESC
LIMIT 1

results.question: Hint: album quantity is found in invoice_items, Find the top 5 customers who bought the most albums in total quantity (across all invoices):
results.sql:
SELECT
  c.CustomerId AS customer_id,
  c.FirstName AS first_name,
  c.LastName AS last_name,
  SUM(ii.Quantity) AS total_quantity
FROM invoice_items ii
JOIN invoices i ON ii.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId
JOIN customers c ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName
ORDER BY total_quantity DESC, c.CustomerId
LIMIT 5

results.question: Find the top 5 customers who spent the most money overall, Hint: order total can be found on invoices table, calculation using invoice_items detail table is unnecessary
results.sql:
SELECT
  c.CustomerId AS customer_id,
  c.FirstName AS first_name,
  c.LastName AS last_name,
  SUM(i.Total) AS total_spent
FROM customers AS c
JOIN invoices AS i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName
ORDER BY total_spent DESC
LIMIT 5

results.question: Get all playlists containing at least 10 tracks and the total duration of those tracks:
results.sql:
SELECT
  p.PlaylistId AS playlist_id,
  p.Name AS playlist_name,
  COUNT(*) AS track_count,
  SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS total_duration_ms,
  SUM(t.Milliseconds) / 60000.0 AS total_duration_minutes
FROM playlists p
JOIN playlist_track pt ON pt.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId
JOIN tracks t ON t.TrackId = pt.TrackId
GROUP BY p.PlaylistId, p.Name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10
ORDER BY p.PlaylistId

results.question: Identify artists who have albums with tracks appearing in multiple genres:
results.sql:
SELECT
  ar.ArtistId AS artist_id,
  ar.Name AS artist_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT t.GenreId) AS genre_count
FROM artists ar
JOIN albums al ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId
JOIN tracks t ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId
WHERE t.GenreId IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY ar.ArtistId, ar.Name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT t.GenreId) > 1
ORDER BY genre_count DESC, artist_name
